reward.force_truth: Native actual workpiece-normal force, every physical tick incl startup.
reward.running_reward: Negative elapsed time times weighted native mean squared normal error, interval force peak excess squared, configured travel objective, true current squared and issued-action changes squared.
reward.failure: Contact loss/travel stop terminates with negative fixed penalty; horizon truncation bootstraps final causal observation.
reward.travel_reward: Zero/default optional weak mean-square cost inside the acceptable band; outside it, dt times squared interval-peak excess from native min/max travel. This is an interval-peak penalty, not an excess MSE.
reward.excluded: No teacher action, future profile, inferred-force-only reward or sample-rate-dependent discount.

policyWarmStart.note: Policy-only warm start preserves normalized neural weights; the runtime physical action contract is versioned separately.
